## 📖 Scenario

*Velammal Engineering College, Department of Computer Science and Engineering —
Academic Performance Monitoring System, Even Semester 2024-25.* The department
tracks **1,200 students** across sections A–D, recording attendance, study habits,
lab performance, assignments, internal assessments, coding practice, library usage
and weekly assessment dates throughout the semester, culminating in the final exam.

## 📑 Column Documentation

| # | Column | Type | Range / Values | Description |
|---|--------|------|----------------|-------------|
| 1 | `student_id` | string | `CSE2024_0001` … `CSE2024_1200` | Unique roll number (no duplicates) |
| 2 | `student_name` | string | 1,200 unique names | Fictional first + last name |
| 3 | `department` | category | CSE (900), CSE-AI (200), CSE-DS (100) | Programme enrolled |
| 4 | `semester` | int | 2 (400), 4 (350), 6 (300), 8 (150) | Current semester |
| 5 | `section` | category | A, B, C, D | Class section |
| 6 | `gender` | category | Male 55%, Female 43%, Other 2% | Fictional demographic |
| 7 | `attendance_percentage` | float | 40.0 – 100.0 (μ≈78, σ≈12) | Classes attended % |
| 8 | `study_hours_per_week` | float | 2.0 – 45.0, right-skewed (skew 1.60) | Self-study hours/week |
| 9 | `lab_marks` | float | 0 – 50, left-skewed (skew −0.46) | Lab assessment /50 |
| 10 | `assignment_marks` | float | 0 – 30, left-skewed | Assignments /30 |
| 11 | `internal_marks` | float | 0 – 40 (μ≈28, σ≈7) | Internal test /40 |
| 12 | `previous_semester_cgpa` | float | 4.0 – 10.0 (μ≈7.5) | Prior CGPA |
| 13 | `online_assessment_score` | float | 0 – 100 (μ≈63, σ≈18) | Online quiz average |
| 14 | `library_visits_per_month` | int | 0 – 25 (Poisson, λ≈6) | Library visits/month |
| 15 | `coding_practice_hours_per_week` | float | 0 – 30, right-skewed | Coding practice h/week |
| 16 | `support_sessions_attended` | int | 0 – 10 (Poisson, λ≈3) | Remedial sessions attended |
| 17 | `assessment_date` | date | 2025-01-06 – 2025-04-28 | Weekly assessment day (Mondays + 4 extras) |
| 18 | `final_exam_marks` | float | 0 – 100 (μ≈57.9, σ≈15.2) | **Primary dependent variable** |
| 19 | `final_grade` | category | O, A+, A, B+, B, C, F | Derived from final marks |
| 20 | `pass_status` | category | Pass (1055), Fail (145) | `F` → Fail, else Pass |

### Grade Scale

| Marks | 90–100 | 80–89 | 70–79 | 60–69 | 50–59 | 40–49 | <40 |
|-------|--------|-------|-------|-------|-------|-------|-----|
| Grade | O | A+ | A | B+ | B | C | **F** |

## 🔧 Generation Methodology

1. **Latent ability** — each student gets a hidden `Beta(5,3)` ability score that
   links related features (able students tend to attend and study more).
2. **Marginal distributions** — each column is drawn from its specified
   distribution (Normal / log-normal / Beta / Poisson) and clipped to its range.
3. **Final marks** — standardized (z-scored) features are combined with weights
   plus random exam-day noise, rescaled to μ=58, σ=15, clipped to [0,100].
   Weights are **auto-calibrated** so correlations match the lab targets.
4. **Grade & pass** are strictly derived from `final_exam_marks` (100% consistent).
5. **24 deliberate outliers (2%)** are injected for interesting EDA discussions:

| # | Students | Pattern | Story |
|---|----------|---------|-------|
| 1 | 6 | attendance >95, marks <35 | Present but not engaged |
| 2 | 6 | attendance <55, marks >75 | Self-learners |
| 3 | 4 | study >35 h, marks 45–55 | Inefficient studiers |
| 4 | 4 | coding >25 h, lab <15 | Practicing the wrong things |
| 5 | 4 | support >8, marks >80 | Proactive high performers |

## 📈 Correlation Structure (validated)

| Pair | r | Target |
|------|---|--------|
| study_hours ↔ final_marks | **+0.565** | 0.55 – 0.70 ✅ |
| attendance ↔ final_marks | **+0.475** | 0.45 – 0.60 ✅ |
| coding_hours ↔ lab_marks | **+0.560** | 0.50 – 0.65 ✅ |
| prev_cgpa ↔ final_marks | **+0.432** | 0.40 – 0.55 ✅ |
| library_visits ↔ study_hours | **+0.332** | 0.20 – 0.35 ✅ |
| support_sessions ↔ final_marks | **−0.272** | −0.30 – −0.15 ✅ (struggling students seek help) |
